description: Fetch a single asset by id and return its content, filename, creation time and share URL. Read-only and safe to retry; public assets need no auth, password-protected assets return an error with the share URL, and client-encrypted content is returned as stored. Use search_gallery to find an id, or list_assets for your own uploads.

id.description: 12-character asset id returned by upload or search_gallery.

name: view
